paragraphs.text: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מֵֽאֵילִ֔ם וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ כָּל־עֲדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־מִדְבַּר־סִ֔ין אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּין־אֵילִ֖ם וּבֵ֣ין סִינָ֑י בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י לְצֵאתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

i18n.en: And they journeyed from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Yisra'el came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their going out from the land of Mitsrayim.

paragraphs.text: וילינו [וַיִּלּ֜וֹנוּ] כָּל־עֲדַ֧ת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עַל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְעַֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

i18n.en: And the whole congregation of the children of Yisra'el murmured against Moses and Aharon in the wilderness.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ אֲלֵהֶ֜ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מִֽי־יִתֵּ֨ן מוּתֵ֤נוּ בְיַד־יְהוָה֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּשִׁבְתֵּ֙נוּ֙ עַל־סִ֣יר הַבָּשָׂ֔ר בְּאָכְלֵ֥נוּ לֶ֖חֶם לָשֹׂ֑בַע כִּֽי־הוֹצֵאתֶ֤ם אֹתָ֙נוּ֙ אֶל־הַמִּדְבָּ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה לְהָמִ֛ית אֶת־כָּל־הַקָּהָ֥ל הַזֶּ֖ה בָּרָעָֽב׃ (ס)

i18n.en: And the children of Yisra'el said to them, "Would that we had died by the hand of YHWH in the land of Mitsrayim, when we sat by the pot of meat, when we ate bread to the full; for you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger."

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה הִנְנִ֨י מַמְטִ֥יר לָכֶ֛ם לֶ֖חֶם מִן־הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְיָצָ֨א הָעָ֤ם וְלָֽקְטוּ֙ דְּבַר־י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֔וֹ לְמַ֧עַן אֲנַסֶּ֛נּוּ הֲיֵלֵ֥ךְ בְּתוֹרָתִ֖י אִם־לֹֽא׃

i18n.en: And YHWH said to Moses, "Behold, I am about to rain down for you bread from the heavens; and the people shall go out and gather a day's portion every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in my torah or not.

notes.official: **THE MANNA introduction-verse.** *hinĕnî mamṭîr lāḵem leḥem min-haš-šāmayim* 'behold, I am raining for you bread from the heavens'. See the central entry `mannah-bread-from-heaven-ex-16-quranic-and-nt-cross-corpus-with-disavowals` for the five preserved reading-strata (classical Jewish miraculous-provision; naturalistic tamarisk-honeydew [Bodenheimer 1947]; rabbinic-eschatological *mān ha-ganuz*; Christian-typological John 6 Jesus-as-bread-of-life; Raëlian-canon engineered-nutrition-Elohim-tech-food-drop) and the operational disavowals. Acknowledgment-without-endorsement of the Raëlian-canon's engagement per the Shi'ur Qomah parasangs precedent and the Qur'an *inshiqāq al-qamar* precedent.

paragraphs.text: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י וְהֵכִ֖ינוּ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־יָבִ֑יאוּ וְהָיָ֣ה מִשְׁנֶ֔ה עַ֥ל אֲשֶֽׁר־יִלְקְט֖וּ י֥וֹם ׀ יֽוֹם׃ (ס)

i18n.en: And it shall come to pass on the sixth day that they shall prepare what they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather day by day."

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן אֶֽל־כָּל־בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֶ֕רֶב וִֽידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֧י יְהוָ֛ה הוֹצִ֥יא אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

i18n.en: And Moses and Aharon said to all the children of Yisra'el, "At evening you shall know that YHWH has brought you out from the land of Mitsrayim;

paragraphs.text: וּבֹ֗קֶר וּרְאִיתֶם֙ אֶת־כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה בְּשָׁמְע֥וֹ אֶת־תְּלֻנֹּתֵיכֶ֖ם עַל־יְהוָ֑ה וְנַ֣חְנוּ מָ֔ה כִּ֥י תלונו [תַלִּ֖ינוּ] עָלֵֽינוּ׃

i18n.en: and in the morning you shall see the glory of YHWH, when he hears your murmurings against YHWH. And what are we, that you murmur against us?"

notes.official: *kĕḇôḏ YHWH* 'the glory of YHWH' — the divine-presence-marker (see the existing entry `kavod-yhwh`) appears in the manna-context. The murmuring-against-YHWH theological framing locates the wilderness-complaint pattern as a theophanic-judgment site.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה בְּתֵ֣ת יְהוָה֩ לָכֶ֨ם בָּעֶ֜רֶב בָּשָׂ֣ר לֶאֱכֹ֗ל וְלֶ֤חֶם בַּבֹּ֙קֶר֙ לִשְׂבֹּ֔עַ בִּשְׁמֹ֤עַ יְהוָה֙ אֶת־תְּלֻנֹּ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּ֥ם מַלִּינִ֖ם עָלָ֑יו וְנַ֣חְנוּ מָ֔ה לֹא־עָלֵ֥ינוּ תְלֻנֹּתֵיכֶ֖ם כִּ֥י עַל־יְהוָֽה׃

i18n.en: And Moses said, "When YHWH gives you meat to eat in the evening and bread in the morning to the full — when YHWH hears your murmurings, which you murmur against him — what are we? Your murmurings are not against us but against YHWH."

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֔ן אֱמֹ֗ר אֶֽל־כָּל־עֲדַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל קִרְב֖וּ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֔ע אֵ֖ת תְּלֻנֹּתֵיכֶֽם׃

i18n.en: And Moses said to Aharon, "Say to all the congregation of the children of Yisra'el: 'Draw near before YHWH, for he has heard your murmurings.'"

paragraphs.text: וַיְהִ֗י כְּדַבֵּ֤ר אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל־כָּל־עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּפְנ֖וּ אֶל־הַמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְהִנֵּה֙ כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה נִרְאָ֖ה בֶּעָנָֽן׃ (פ)

i18n.en: And it came to pass, as Aharon spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Yisra'el, that they turned toward the wilderness, and behold, the glory of YHWH appeared in the cloud.

notes.official: The *kĕḇôḏ YHWH* appears in the cloud — *nirʾâ be-ʿānān* — explicit pairing of the kavod-YHWH and the cloud-presence-marker. Cross-corpus to Ex 24:16-17, 40:34-38, Lev 9:6, 9:23, Num 14:10, 16:19, 16:42, 20:6 — the kavod-cloud-pairing is the central Priestly-source theophanic-deployment.

paragraphs.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

i18n.en: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

paragraphs.text: שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי אֶת־תְּלוּנֹּת֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ דַּבֵּ֨ר אֲלֵהֶ֜ם לֵאמֹ֗ר בֵּ֤ין הָֽעַרְבַּ֙יִם֙ תֹּאכְל֣וּ בָשָׂ֔ר וּבַבֹּ֖קֶר תִּשְׂבְּעוּ־לָ֑חֶם וִֽידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

i18n.en: "I have heard the murmurings of the children of Yisra'el. Speak to them, saying: 'Between the evenings you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread; and you shall know that I am YHWH your Elohim.'"

notes.official: *bên hā-ʿarbayim* 'between the evenings' — the dual-evening cultic-temporal phrase. See the overlay entry `bayn-haarbayim-between-the-evenings-temporal-convention-exodus-overlay` for the rabbinic-Mishnaic vs Karaite-Samaritan reading dispute (m. Pesachim 5:1; the Karaite-Samaritan literal-dual-evening reading).

paragraphs.text: וַיְהִ֣י בָעֶ֔רֶב וַתַּ֣עַל הַשְּׂלָ֔ו וַתְּכַ֖ס אֶת־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וּבַבֹּ֗קֶר הָֽיְתָה֙ שִׁכְבַ֣ת הַטַּ֔ל סָבִ֖יב לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

i18n.en: And it came to pass at evening that the quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning there was a layer of dew around the camp.

notes.official: The *śĕlāw* 'quail' meat-provision; cross-corpus to Num 11:31-32 where the quail-of-divine-rage parallel reverses the gift-quail of Ex 16 into a punishment-quail.

paragraphs.text: וַתַּ֖עַל שִׁכְבַ֣ת הַטָּ֑ל וְהִנֵּ֞ה עַל־פְּנֵ֤י הַמִּדְבָּר֙ דַּ֣ק מְחֻסְפָּ֔ס דַּ֥ק כַּכְּפֹ֖ר עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

i18n.en: And the layer of dew lifted, and behold, on the face of the wilderness was a fine, flaky substance, fine as the frost on the ground.

notes.official: *daq mĕḥuspās* — true hapax-legomenon at the *mĕḥuspās* form. The WoH-Translation preserves 'a fine, flaky substance' per the ASV/RSV-baseline; see the overlay entry `mehuspas-fine-flaky-substance-hapax-exodus-16-14-overlay` for the hapax-dispute.

paragraphs.text: וַיִּרְא֣וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ אִ֤ישׁ אֶל־אָחִיו֙ מָ֣ן ה֔וּא כִּ֛י לֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּ מַה־ה֑וּא וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם ה֣וּא הַלֶּ֔חֶם אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה לָכֶ֖ם לְאָכְלָֽה׃

i18n.en: And the children of Yisra'el saw it and said to one another, "What is it?" — for they did not know what it was. And Moses said to them, "It is the bread which YHWH has given you to eat.

notes.official: The *mān-hûʾ* etymological-question 'what is it?' establishes the folk-etymological aetiology of the substance-name. The Hebrew narrative locates the etymology in the unknowing question — the people see the substance and ask 'what is it?', and the substance becomes named after the question (Sarna 1989 *Exodus*).

paragraphs.text: זֶ֤ה הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה לִקְט֣וּ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ אִ֖ישׁ לְפִ֣י אָכְל֑וֹ עֹ֣מֶר לַגֻּלְגֹּ֗לֶת מִסְפַּר֙ נַפְשֹׁ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אִ֛ישׁ לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּאָהֳל֖וֹ תִּקָּֽחוּ׃

i18n.en: This is the word that YHWH has commanded: 'Gather of it, each one according to his eating — an omer per head, according to the number of your souls; each shall take for those who are in his tent.'"

paragraphs.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ־כֵ֖ן בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיִּלְקְט֔וּ הַמַּרְבֶּ֖ה וְהַמַּמְעִֽיט׃

i18n.en: And the children of Yisra'el did so; and they gathered, some more, some less.

paragraphs.text: וַיָּמֹ֣דּוּ בָעֹ֔מֶר וְלֹ֤א הֶעְדִּיף֙ הַמַּרְבֶּ֔ה וְהַמַּמְעִ֖יט לֹ֣א הֶחְסִ֑יר אִ֥ישׁ לְפִֽי־אָכְל֖וֹ לָקָֽטוּ׃

i18n.en: And they measured it with the omer; and he who had gathered much had nothing left over, and he who had gathered little had no lack; each had gathered according to his eating.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אִ֕ישׁ אַל־יוֹתֵ֥ר מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַד־בֹּֽקֶר׃

i18n.en: And Moses said to them, "Let no one leave any of it until morning."

paragraphs.text: וְלֹא־שָׁמְע֣וּ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיּוֹתִ֨רוּ אֲנָשִׁ֤ים מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ עַד־בֹּ֔קֶר וַיָּ֥רֻם תּוֹלָעִ֖ים וַיִּבְאַ֑שׁ וַיִּקְצֹ֥ף עֲלֵהֶ֖ם מֹשֶֽׁה׃

i18n.en: But they did not listen to Moses; some of them left part of it until morning, and it bred worms and stank; and Moses was angry with them.

paragraphs.text: וַיִּלְקְט֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֔קֶר אִ֖ישׁ כְּפִ֣י אָכְל֑וֹ וְחַ֥ם הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ וְנָמָֽס׃

i18n.en: And they gathered it morning by morning, each one according to his eating; and when the sun grew hot, it melted.

paragraphs.text: וַיְהִ֣י ׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁ֗י לָֽקְט֥וּ לֶ֙חֶם֙ מִשְׁנֶ֔ה שְׁנֵ֥י הָעֹ֖מֶר לָאֶחָ֑ד וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ כָּל־נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הָֽעֵדָ֔ה וַיַּגִּ֖ידוּ לְמֹשֶֽׁה׃

i18n.en: And it came to pass on the sixth day that they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one; and all the leaders of the congregation came and told Moses.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם ה֚וּא אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שַׁבָּת֧וֹן שַׁבַּת־קֹ֛דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָ֖ה מָחָ֑ר אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־תֹּאפ֞וּ אֵפ֗וּ וְאֵ֤ת אֲשֶֽׁר־תְּבַשְּׁלוּ֙ בַּשֵּׁ֔לוּ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־הָ֣עֹדֵ֔ף הַנִּ֧יחוּ לָכֶ֛ם לְמִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת עַד־הַבֹּֽקֶר׃

i18n.en: And he said to them, "This is what YHWH has spoken: 'Tomorrow is a Sabbath observance, a holy Sabbath to YHWH; bake what you will bake, and boil what you will boil; and all that is left over, put aside for yourselves to be kept until the morning.'"

notes.official: **First sabbath-observance institutional command** — *šabbāṯôn šabbaṯ-qōḏeš* 'a Sabbath-observance, a holy Sabbath' (the doubled noun preserved on the surface). The verse predates the Decalogue Sabbath commandment at Ex 20:8-11 within the narrative sequence; see the central entry `shabbat-creation-grounding-vs-exodus-grounding-deuteronomic-variant-cross-corpus`.

paragraphs.text: וַיַּנִּ֤יחוּ אֹתוֹ֙ עַד־הַבֹּ֔קֶר כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְלֹ֣א הִבְאִ֔ישׁ וְרִמָּ֖ה לֹא־הָ֥יְתָה בּֽוֹ׃

i18n.en: And they put it aside until the morning, as Moses had commanded; and it did not stink, and there were no worms in it.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אִכְלֻ֣הוּ הַיּ֔וֹם כִּֽי־שַׁבָּ֥ת הַיּ֖וֹם לַיהוָ֑ה הַיּ֕וֹם לֹ֥א תִמְצָאֻ֖הוּ בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃

i18n.en: And Moses said, "Eat it today, for today is a Sabbath to YHWH; today you shall not find it in the field.

paragraphs.text: שֵׁ֥שֶׁת יָמִ֖ים תִּלְקְטֻ֑הוּ וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֛י שַׁבָּ֖ת לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה־בּֽוֹ׃

i18n.en: Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day, the Sabbath, there will be none on it."

paragraphs.text: וַֽיְהִי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י יָצְא֥וּ מִן־הָעָ֖ם לִלְקֹ֑ט וְלֹ֖א מָצָֽאוּ׃ (ס)

i18n.en: And it came to pass on the seventh day that some of the people went out to gather, and they found none.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֑ה עַד־אָ֙נָה֙ מֵֽאַנְתֶּ֔ם לִשְׁמֹ֥ר מִצְוֺתַ֖י וְתוֹרֹתָֽי׃

i18n.en: And YHWH said to Moses, "How long will you refuse to keep my commandments and my instructions?

paragraphs.text: רְא֗וּ כִּֽי־יְהוָה֮ נָתַ֣ן לָכֶ֣ם הַשַּׁבָּת֒ עַל־כֵּ֠ן ה֣וּא נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶ֛ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁ֖י לֶ֣חֶם יוֹמָ֑יִם שְׁב֣וּ ׀ אִ֣ישׁ תַּחְתָּ֗יו אַל־יֵ֥צֵא אִ֛ישׁ מִמְּקֹמ֖וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃

i18n.en: See, because YHWH has given you the Sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day bread for two days; let every man stay in his place; let no man go out from his place on the seventh day."

notes.official: The double-portion-on-the-sixth-day institution: the manna-cycle structurally encodes the Sabbath-rest pattern that the Decalogue will then formalize at Ex 20:8-11.

paragraphs.text: וַיִּשְׁבְּת֥וּ הָעָ֖ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִעִֽי׃

i18n.en: So the people rested on the seventh day.

paragraphs.text: וַיִּקְרְא֧וּ בֵֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ מָ֑ן וְה֗וּא כְּזֶ֤רַע גַּד֙ לָבָ֔ן וְטַעְמ֖וֹ כְּצַפִּיחִ֥ת בִּדְבָֽשׁ׃

i18n.en: And the house of Yisra'el called its name Man (manna); and it was like coriander seed, white, and its taste was like a wafer made with honey.

notes.official: The substance-naming and descriptive-details: *kĕ-zeraʿ gaḏ lāḇān* 'like coriander seed, white', *kĕ-ṣappîḥîṯ bi-ḏḇāš* 'like a wafer with honey'. The descriptive-details align reasonably well with the Bodenheimer 1947 tamarisk-honeydew naturalistic-correlate; documented at the central entry as one of the five reading-strata.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה זֶ֤ה הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה מְלֹ֤א הָעֹ֙מֶר֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ לְמִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶ֑ם לְמַ֣עַן ׀ יִרְא֣וּ אֶת־הַלֶּ֗חֶם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶאֱכַ֤לְתִּי אֶתְכֶם֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר בְּהוֹצִיאִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

i18n.en: And Moses said, "This is the word that YHWH has commanded: 'Let a full omer of it be kept for your generations, that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the land of Mitsrayim.'"

notes.official: The manna-jar memorial institution; cross-corpus to the rabbinic-eschatological *mān ha-ganuz* 'hidden manna' tradition (b. Hag. 12b) and the NT Rev 2:17 *to manna to kekrymmenon* reactivation. Heb 9:4 deploys the manna-jar as one of the items in the Ark.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֗ן קַ֚ח צִנְצֶ֣נֶת אַחַ֔ת וְתֶן־שָׁ֥מָּה מְלֹֽא־הָעֹ֖מֶר מָ֑ן וְהַנַּ֤ח אֹתוֹ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְמִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

i18n.en: And Moses said to Aharon, "Take one jar and put a full omer of manna in it, and place it before YHWH to be kept for your generations."

paragraphs.text: כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיַּנִּיחֵ֧הוּ אַהֲרֹ֛ן לִפְנֵ֥י הָעֵדֻ֖ת לְמִשְׁמָֽרֶת׃

i18n.en: As YHWH had commanded Moses, so Aharon placed it before the Testimony, to be kept.

paragraphs.text: וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אָֽכְל֤וּ אֶת־הַמָּן֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה עַד־בֹּאָ֖ם אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ נוֹשָׁ֑בֶת אֶת־הַמָּן֙ אָֽכְל֔וּ עַד־בֹּאָ֕ם אֶל־קְצֵ֖ה אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃

i18n.en: And the children of Yisra'el ate the manna forty years, until they came to an inhabited land; they ate the manna until they came to the edge of the land of Canaan.

paragraphs.text: וְהָעֹ֕מֶר עֲשִׂרִ֥ית הָאֵיפָ֖ה הֽוּא׃ (פ)

i18n.en: Now the omer is a tenth of an ephah.
